scope: Phone screen wording, flow, theme and component choices in app/. Fixed move, practice, science and source records are displayed verbatim; new screen wording makes no new science claims.
componentKit: React and Material UI; all controls and layout use the component kit. Fonts and colors match the pass 32 print theme. Theme values and shared component defaults live in app/theme.js.
privacy: Local preview, made-up families only until config.zeroRetentionApproved. No photo input. Local accounts and kit evidence stay under context/local-app. No deployment or public hosting.
smallSpill: A measured spill up to 24 points may reclaim heading top padding and heading/panel gaps before paid shortening. Body type, paragraph gaps, artwork sizes, words, margins and five pages stay intact.
deferred: Real family and photo likeness use pending zero retention
Three generated people portraits to choose from
Live research for new move records

parentVerdict.immediateHelp: Local first response before login or people setup. Prepared practice stays verbatim and is explicitly optional. Unknown concerns get neutral feeling/help examples, never a padded list.
parentVerdict.roles: Self criticism leads to asking for help or naming the feeling, because Coach voice rehearses anger at someone else. Exclusion targets do not get the witness-chat move. Test nerves lead to test-compatible records. Sibling shoves get a calm pause before repair; record wording is not adapted into new advice.
parentVerdict.safety: Existing danger stops retained and inflections/repeated physical harm recognized. Parent-only guidance and verified StopBullying.gov links are in parent-safety.json for Sunny to read. No move sources were added or changed.
parentVerdict.science: FORMAT retains one modest honest science idea whispered once. Detailed methods, age ranges, citations and full limitations stay in the existing parent notes. Both models see the same rule; narrow deterministic lecture forms request a story repair on newly written stories. Existing bought stories remain evidence.
parentVerdict.exampleName: Own-name positive-action examples keep instruction/action verbatim except removal of the sample vocative after Use your name. Applies to any sample name, across poster, request and interactive presentations. This removes Sam without transmitting a family name to pictures or changing move/practice records.
parentVerdict.wait: About 10 minutes is an observation from the two consumer-test kits, not a performance promise or timeout. Shown before starting and during work. Picture checks belong to Drawing; only final export reaches Checking; progress never retreats.
parentVerdict.children: One local login, separate child files/history/feedback/reference paths/chapter numbers; primary legacy family.json and kit folders stay in place. Whole-family daily dollar/three-kit limits remain shared. No child-facing account.
parentVerdict.headings: Chapter title and identity wrap at the existing sizes inside the same header. No words, margins, panels or pages removed. Fresh visual measurement remains unverified.
